gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histological diagnosis of meningioma according to the WHO 2021 classification

candidate_evidence.quote: Arm A (interventional arm): REGORAFENIB 40 mg tablets once daily (160 mg/die), 3 weeks on, 1 week off, until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

role_evidence.quote: Arm A (interventional arm): REGORAFENIB 40 mg tablets once daily (160 mg/die), 3 weeks on, 1 week off, until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Inhibits angiogenic receptor tyrosine kinases (VEGFR1/2/3), PDGFRB, FGFR1 and c-RAF/RAF1 and BRAF signalling

coder_notes: Recurrent meningioma only; glioblastoma is mentioned in the summary solely as a past regorafenib result (REGOMA), so not_glioblastoma. The control arm 'Local Standard of Care' names no drug (record says there are no drugs with indication), so no agent row for it.
